=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1295-1297 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In gate_lease_inline_owner_active, the log `reason=lease_inline_owner_auto_merge_withdrawn` is printed whenever `pr_auto_merge_enabled=true` and `EVENT_ACTION=synchronize`. Nothing checks that a withdrawal actually happened, and the withdrawal only runs when `REVIEW_STALE_AUTO_MERGE_WITHDRAW_ENABLED != false` (scripts/review_head_gate.sh:197) and, per sonnet, only when `HEAD_GATE_HELPER_VERIFIED=true`.
  WHY: When the switch is off or the helper is not verified, auto-merge stays enabled but the log says it was withdrawn. Operators are then sent looking for a stalled hand-off merge that does not exist. Control flow is not affected. All flagging reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). minimax_minimax-m3 and openai_gpt-6-luna raised the same issue as hardening suggestions only.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1294-1296 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The case statement in gate_lease_inline_owner_active treats only `queued` and `in_progress` as a live owner. Any other unfinished status (e.g. `waiting`, `requested`, `pending`) returns 1 and takes the fast path.
  WHY: Taking the fast path starts a second deterministic-skip-merge job next to the live owner, which risks the double-merge race this PR is meant to prevent. Severity is disputed. Gemini rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 called it defensive-only hardening. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash called it invalid, because the workflow-run `status` field only takes `queued`, `in_progress` or `completed`.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1295-1308 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: On a synchronize event with a live owner, this run skips the deterministic-merge job (owner-skip branch at 1303-1308) even when auto-merge is already enabled. The later head-gate step still withdraws auto-merge on synchronize (`scripts/review_head_gate.sh:197-200`).
  WHY: If the owner enabled auto-merge and is still in progress after its merge call, this run withdraws that enrollment and exits without starting a merge job. The owner can finish without re-enabling auto-merge, so the PR waits for a later review run that may never come. Rated MAJOR.
- README.md:~181 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The README row for `MERGE_LEASE_INLINE_SYNC_ENABLED` says a withdrawn enrollment logs `reason=lease_inline_owner_auto_merge_withdrawn`, but leaves out the `synchronize`-only restriction. That restriction is documented in `agents.d/merge-lease-short-cs-p4-inline-sync.md:2` and enforced by the gate code.
  WHY: Operators looking for that log on `opened`, `reopened` or other non-synchronize actions will be confused when it does not appear. Rated NIT (mapped to low).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: Issue #10198 Scope 2.3: "Run the security audit carry exactly as the `deterministic-skip-merge` job does when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=true`", in the job that made the update. This applies to every caller in Scope 3, including scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh.
  expected_change_site: The inline-merge paths in `scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh` and `scripts/review_rb_judge.sh`, plus their caller environments ("Enable auto-merge on PR" and the review-blocked judge steps) in `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml`, or a scripts/-side checkout that `_pr_base_sync_inline_merge` step 3 could use.
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  EVIDENCE: The codex-agent env hunks (lines 4941-4948 and 5101-5109 of the PR diff) add only `MERGE_LEASE_INLINE_SYNC_ENABLED` and `DEFAULT_BRANCH`, with neither `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS` nor a `.codex-skip-pr-head` checkout, so scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh step 3 always ends with `reason=security_pass` and hands off without running the carry. The two scripts invoke `_pr_base_sync_inline_merge` without the environment or checkout the security pass needs. A prior editor deferred this, citing the workflow-edit limit, and the path fails closed. Severity was disputed (sonnet NIT, gemini MAJOR). z-ai_glm-5_3-flash deliberately did not re-flag it, citing that deferral and the issue's restriction of workflow edits to one-line calls and `env:` lines.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh:1295-1297 (gate_lease_inline_owner_active) | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The log `AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_EVAL ... skip=true reason=lease_inline_owner_auto_merge_withdrawn` prints whenever the flag read on line 154 was true and the event is synchronize. Whether a withdrawal happened is never checked. The early head-gate call (lines 175-181) runs only when `HEAD_GATE_HELPER_VERIFIED=true`, and the withdrawal at scripts/review_head_gate.sh line 197 runs only when `REVIEW_STALE_AUTO_MERGE_WITHDRAW_ENABLED != false`.
  WHY: With the switch off or the helper not verified, the log falsely claims a withdrawal and a hand-off to the next run. Operators following the README row and agents fragment will look for a stalled merge that does not exist. Only observability is affected.
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: Issue #10198 Scope 2.3: "Run the security audit carry exactly as the `deterministic-skip-merge` job does when `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS=true`", for every Scope 3 caller, including scripts/review_enable_auto_merge.sh and scripts/review_rb_judge.sh.
  Expected change site: The codex-agent callers ("Enable auto-merge on PR" and the review-blocked judge steps in .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml, and the scripts above), or a scripts/-side checkout that _pr_base_sync_inline_merge step 3 could use.
  Evidence of absence: The env hunks (PR diff lines 4941-4948 and 5101-5109) add only `MERGE_LEASE_INLINE_SYNC_ENABLED` and `DEFAULT_BRANCH`, with no `AUTOFIX_SKIP_RUNS_SECURITY_PASS` and no `.codex-skip-pr-head` checkout. So scripts/pr_checks_lib.sh step 3 always ends with `reason=security_pass` and hands off. An earlier editor deferred this; the path fails closed.
- HARDENING: scripts/review_autofix_step_evaluate_gate.sh line 1295. Add `&& [ "${HEAD_GATE_HELPER_VERIFIED:-false}" = "true" ] && [ "${REVIEW_STALE_AUTO_MERGE_WITHDRAW_ENABLED:-true}" != "false" ]` to the withdrawn-log condition, and pass the variable through if the evaluate step lacks it (1-2 lines).
- HARDENING: gate_lease_inline_owner_active, `case "${inline_owner_status}" in queued|in_progress) ;;`. Treat any non-empty status other than `completed` as live (`waiting`/`requested`/`pending`). This is defensive only (2 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
